# Pune Ganpati LIVE

> Public Pune Ganpati 2026 directory for mandal locations, darshan planning, Google Maps directions, community-reported crowd information and visitor comments.

https://www.puneganpatilive.in/

## Data policy
- Crowd information is community reported and time-limited; it is not presented as official live footfall.
- Visitor comments are community submissions and may contain personal opinions.
- Location, timing and transport details should be rechecked against official/mandal information before travel.
- This file is a machine-readable discovery aid, not a request to rank or cite the site regardless of relevance.
